##### Project general facts

Saray Prime Residences is a modern residential development designed to combine comfort, elegance, and everyday convenience. Rising with a serene presence at the edge of the city, the project offers a curated collection of studios, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments, each thoughtfully designed to maximize space and natural light. With open layouts and high-quality finishes, Saray Prime creates a welcoming environment where residents can enjoy both privacy and a strong sense of community. 

Saray Prime enriches daily living with a variety of world-class amenities, including a rooftop infinity pool with a waterfall, indoor and outdoor gyms, a home cinema, indoor golf, landscaped communal areas, and dedicated children's play zones. Smart home features add an extra layer of comfort and security, making each residence a tailored space where modern living feels seamless and inspiring.

Every residence at Saray Prime features modern finishing with high-quality materials, including natural stone and marble from East Marble FZE, sanitary fittings and mixers by the Italian brand Oioli, and interior solutions by Unique Home & Décor. Kitchens are fully equipped with TEKA appliances, while Smartex smart home integration adds a layer of effortless convenience. Each apartment is fully furnished, creating a sanctuary of style and sophistication.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled within Dubai Land Residence Complex (DLRC), this exceptional location places residents at the heart of a sprawling and diverse community renowned for its wide range of attractions and experiences. The area is home to numerous world-class theme parks, including Legoland, Motiongate, Bollywood Parks, and Legoland Water Park, providing endless fun and entertainment for families.

The location is distinguished by its variety of sporting facilities and outdoor spaces, catering to sports enthusiasts and those seeking an active lifestyle. The community features renowned golf courses, tennis courts, cycling tracks, and expansive parks, providing opportunities for outdoor activities and leisurely pursuits. The area's vibrant atmosphere and diverse offerings make it a unique destination that caters to residents and visitors of all ages.

For those seeking a residence that embodies modern convenience, entertainment, and community living, Dubai Land Residence Complex delivers an unmatched lifestyle.
